summary: Intermountain Health (5 locations) is planning a holiday seasonal sale (Nov 16–Jan 1) offering 25% off select memberships and needed guidance on how to route prospects from a custom landing page into a streamlined TeamBuildr OS purchase flow. Several OS limitations (post-login redirect breaking session, inability to scope promo codes to specific memberships, no member-controlled delayed start dates, no gift/third-party purchase flow) make a fully OS-native solution impractical for this cycle. The agreed interim approach is to run the sale through their existing "classes and events" platform, then hand off to OS when members are ready to activate, with manual profile creation and offline transaction logging in OS for KPI tracking.
